defect: marginal_table() scored the supplied-label (known) MetricContext with mask `region & ~known`. That context's truth set IS the supplied label pixels, so the mask erased every truth pixel: truth_pixels=0 on all 12 rows, dti=None, TP_w=FN_w=0, break_even_credit_per_pixel=None. The published table was therefore vacuous.
scope: Diagnostic only. The marginal table is written after selection-frozen.json and is not read by the selection rule, the audit rows, the exported rasters or the publisher. The selected/wide policies and all three portfolio files are unaffected.
fix: marginal_table(contexts, known_ctx, ...) now scores every proxy with the same mask the selection sweep used (`faithful(contexts, p, region, known)` plus the leakage-free known_proxy emission for the held-out supplied labels), reports the primary proxy's per-pixel economics, the robust minimum over all proxies, and per_proxy detail, and raises if any tranche is unscorable. Regression test: tests/test_coverage.py::test_marginal_table_scores_the_supplied_labels_instead_of_erasing_them
rerun: outputs/coverage-v3 (second run, same config hash, log: evidence/coverage-v3-run.txt)
